### Is your request related to a problem?
A clear and concise description of what the issue or bottleneck is. (e.g. "I find it hard to track my score without weekly trends.")

### Describe the Solution You'd Like
A detailed description of your proposed enhancement.

### Alternatives Considered
List any alternative approaches you've considered.

### Technical Feasibility
Describe how this fits into our current tech stack (Node, Express, MongoDB, Docker).
